name: UK: premium, service and 070 personal numbers
description: Warns about calls from 070 personal numbers, 0843/0844/0845 and 087 service numbers, and 09 premium-rate numbers. Calling them back can be expensive.
author: Parley

sources.title: Ofcom: telecoms numbering (070 personal numbering; 084, 087 and 09 unbundled-tariff ranges)
Ofcom: guidance on the acceptable use of 070 numbers
Ofcom: The National Telephone Numbering Plan (22 April 2025)

notes: Businesses use 084 and 087 numbers legitimately, so this only warns.
